name: D'Vorah recovers Shinnok's amulet from Mileena's camp
description: Cassie and D'Vorah reach the container holding the talisman, and D'Vorah opens it and takes possession of Shinnok's amulet. This Event records recovery from Mileena's rebel camp only; Mileena's later capture/execution and D'Vorah's later betrayal or theft remain outside this slice.
